signal: FloQast launched an AI Agent Builder and expanded AI capabilities at its TakeControl event (Sept 2025)

email.body1:
Dylan, saw FloQast unveiled its AI Agent Builder and expanded AI capabilities at TakeControl.

A push like that opens more accounting teams as prospects than an inside-sales team can personally cover before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for FloQast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dylan, quick follow-up for FloQast.

A new AI launch usually expands the in-market list faster than headcount can keep up, and the coverage gap shows up late as a missed quarter. Most inside-sales teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings FloQast needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dylan, last bit of proof for FloQast.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FloQast's reply rate likely compares to other fintech SaaS vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dylan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a new AI product line is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an inside-sales motion? I'll tailor it to FloQast either way.
